summary: Safebucket is a self-hosted file sharing platform released under the Apache-2.0 licence. It uses pluggable infrastructure to route uploads and downloads directly between client browsers and S3-compatible object storage.
goodFor: It suits administrators who want to provide a drag-and-drop file transfer interface while storing all binary data directly in their existing S3 buckets.
watchOut: The project has a moderate maintenance health score and an older repository footprint, meaning you should evaluate its long-term stability before relying on it for critical workflows.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a Docker container built with Go, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination, while persistent configuration data should be mapped to a local volume.
